body.p: Sands & McDougall's directory of Victoria, 1925. 3,420 pages.
State Library Victoria has digitised this directory, and you can read it online.
Its Carlton listings are on the site's maps, and new entries that use one of its listings link here as their source.
The listings here come from the 1925 directory's Carlton section, pp. 230–243, with Lincoln Place, Lincoln Square and the little streets on p. 287.
The project covers the area south of Grattan Street, west of Swanston Street, east of Elizabeth Street and north of Victoria Street, and only the listings inside it are kept here.
